dedupe_keys.name: simstock urban building energy modelling from geographic data to energyplus ucl

description: SimStock, developed at University College London by Ivan Korolija, Oliver Smith and Shyam Amrith, is a Python package that turns geographic and contextual building data into EnergyPlus models and runs thermal simulations, forming a layer between data sources and EnergyPlus so that urban building energy models can be run from tools such as QGIS. It performs geometric pre-processing so inputs meet EnergyPlus requirements, creates thermal zone objects, and runs simulations and handles results, through two objects: a SimstockDataframe extending pandas and an IDFmanager. Coverage: generic, any building stock with footprint data. Access: pip install simstock, with documentation on Read the Docs. Licence: MIT. Caveats: it requires Python 3.11 to 3.13 and an EnergyPlus 8.9 installation, an older EnergyPlus release. Simulation uses: stock-level heating, cooling and overheating studies from GIS data. Related records: EnergyPlus, CityBES and umi.
